facts.fact: The latest results are Swachh Survekshan 2024-25, whose awards the President conferred on 17 July 2025
facts.quote: Posted On: 17 JUL 2025 2:18PM by PIB Delhi The results are out! Hon'ble President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu conferred Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 Awards at Vigyan Bhagwan, New Delhi
facts.note: sbmurban.org's press releases up to 5 Oct 2026 announce no later results (it lists only the SS 2025-26 toolkit).

facts.fact: Indore, Surat and Navi Mumbai entered the new Super Swachh League (the earlier top cities, ranked separately)
facts.quote: President Confers Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 Awards Indore, Surat, Navi Mumbai enter the premier Super Swachh League Ahmedabad, Bhopal, and Lucknow emerge as India’s New Clean Cities

facts.fact: Among cities of more than 10 lakh population, Ahmedabad is the top Swachh Shehar, followed by Bhopal and Lucknow
facts.quote: B. Presidential Awardees: Swachh Shehar in 5 Population Categories Population S. No. Category State City 1. More than 10 Lakh GUJARAT AHMEDABAD 2. MADHYA PRADESH BHOPAL 3. UTTAR PRADESH LUCKNOW
facts.note: The PIB release says 'Ahmedabad, Bhopal and Lucknow emerging as top Swachh Shehar' in that order.

behaviour: Names the latest Swachh Survekshan edition (2024-25, results 17 July 2025) with its date and cites sbmurban.org / MoHUA (PIB); explains that Indore, Surat and Navi Mumbai are in the separate Super Swachh League and Ahmedabad topped the 10 lakh+ category.
fail_if: Presents an older edition (2023 or earlier) as the latest; gives no edition or date; cites news sites.
summary: Added SS 2024-25 (17 July 2025) as the latest edition: Indore, Surat, Navi Mumbai in the Super Swachh League; Ahmedabad top in 10 lakh+ (PIB release and awardee list).
